notes: Same printer as handle p1s: the refurbished page links the same spec sheet twice ("Download P1S TDS" and FAQ 4 "technical specifications", byte-identical files) and carries the same P1P | P1S table, so every manufacturer value here is the P1S's. The page has two versions (P1S, P1S AMS Combo) and no P1S AMS 2 Pro Combo.
Store table segment 3 ("P1S AMS 2 Combo: Package size 480 × 480 × 565 mm³, Gross weight (AMS included) 21kg") is not written: no version value of this page matches it.

Spec-sheet rows with no registry key, not written: "Chamber Temperature Regulator Fan: Closed Loop Control" (neither thermal.chamber_exhaust_fan nor thermal.chamber_circulation_fan is what the sheet says; both are therefore also left out of not_published) and "USB Output Power: 5V/1.5A" (no USB-output key).

Left out on purpose (neither a spec nor not_published): the dual-nozzle keys (extrusion.main_/aux_extruder_*, printing.filament_main_hotend / filament_aux_hotend*), printing.working_area (laser), the maker-electronics keys electrical.battery / electrical.connector, electrical.requirements (already on the store page, us_110v), and the keys no product document carries (identity.*, carton.*, compat.statement, part.material, variant.note, package.volume_m3, manufacturer_terms.*). package.contents is written per version (P1S from the P1S box wiki, P1S AMS Combo from the combo wiki add-ons) because the page parse binds the combo add-ons to the P1S value; the product-level box stays the store page's list.
The refurbished-condition sentences (function-tested, cleaned, cosmetic imperfections, final inspection) and the page's warranty sentence are store prose, not specs: not written.
Marketing numbers not recorded beyond the two prose rows marked unverified: the banner alt text "Up to 20000 mm/s2 acceleration" (the sheet's 20 m/s² is recorded instead).

printing.unsupported_filament is not_published: the sheet rates fibre-reinforced polymer "Not Recommended" (kept in printing.supported_filament with that rating) and names no filament "not supported".

Adjudication against the second extraction (242 field disagreements), each checked in the cached document. 133 are the same fact written differently (locator separators and wording, the "Base" section label, the included plate's two names in one relation, "M3*14*5 Screws" vs the wiki's rendered "M3145 Screws" (the wiki's Markdown turned the asterisks into italics), the PEI-plate box row with or without its Marks cell, the slicer sentence). Of the 109 others: supported filament is the sheet's three rated rows (the second's reading, 2); printing.unsupported_filament is dropped as a value and listed as not_published, the sheet naming no filament "not supported" (4 removed); package.contents per version from the two box wikis replaces the page parse's mis-scoped P1S row (the second's rows, 8 added); kept from the first extraction after checking the page, the wikis and the sheet (95): Wi-Fi and Bluetooth as their own keys and Bambu-Bus as the interface (the sheet's one Connectivity row), odometry as a boolean (the registry's type) with the sheet's "Optional with AMS" as its condition, the three prose rows (unverified), the relation handles and conditions, the requires relations, the intro-sentence box items and 23 not_published keys. Weights are written as published (kg); the merge stores grams. motion.max_acceleration is unverified: the sheet's 20 m/s² converted to the registry's mm/s² is not in its own quote. Store-page quotes are split with "…" where the page source puts markup or an HTML entity (mm³) inside the words.

Dropped at commit: the package.contents row of the P1S value (P1S box, wiki p1s-acc-in-the-box) is not carried. Two of its items as written, the filament sample whose colour is chosen at random and the warranty leaflet, are refused by the import payload's customer-text check (assertImportPayload), which would refuse the whole product. The store page's own package.contents row for that value (its AMS combo add-on lists) is therefore not replaced by this file.
